context.en: Later portrayal of Emperor Wen, who ordered the new capital; a detail of the composite Thirteen Emperors scroll, not a construction scene.
context.zh: 下令营建者隋文帝的后世图像，取自含后补部分的《历代帝王图》，并非工程现场图。

context.en: Later image of the emperor who ordered the capital and canal works. The ruler and attendants show court hierarchy, not the laborers or construction site.
context.zh: 下令营建都城与运河者的后世图像；君主与侍从表现朝廷等级，而非工役或施工现场。

context.en: Later portrait of Emperor Yang, whose proposed journey explains the order for dragon-boat passage, palaces and supplies.
context.zh: 隋炀帝的后世画像；其巡行计划与河道通龙舟、设置驿宫和草顿的命令相连。

context.en: The emperor who commissioned the Jingkou–Yuhang works, shown in a later portrait rather than a map of the canal.
context.zh: 下令开京口至余杭河道者的后世画像，并非运河线路图。

context.en: A fourteenth-century remembrance of Genghis Khan, whose campaign the entry follows. It is not a battlefield likeness or eyewitness record.
context.zh: 十四世纪追绘的成吉思汗形象；本条叙述其战役，画像不是战地写生或目击记录。

context.en: Genghis Khan’s later imperial portrait accompanies the 1226 campaign account; it neither shows the siege nor depicts the later Yijina administration.
context.zh: 成吉思汗的后世帝像对应1226年战役叙事，既非围城场面，也不表现后来的亦集乃行政机构。

context.en: Emperor Wu appears at left, facing Emperor Jing at right, in a later imperial album. The paired rulers are not an illustration of the Luntai decree being issued.
context.zh: 后世帝王册页左为汉武帝、右为汉景帝；两位君主的图像并非发布轮台诏令的场面。
